HUMAN DECISION 2026-10-03 ~05:30Z, relayed verbatim by the operator (the human chose the "fast plan" in the operator session; record it in missions/01-greenfield-core/NOTES.md as a human decision and amend the mission plan-lock stamp with rig scope mission approve --re-approve --on-behalf-of human@kernel, decision text below).

Decision text: "fast plan: (1) slice plan-locks for 02-analytics, 03-operate and every later slice in missions 01-03 are delegated to the orchestration lead (tier low, urlshort-slice-delegated; the lead records its approval reasoning); mission plan-locks and ship sign-offs stay with the human; 01-create-redirect keeps its human plan-lock already in flight. (2) Scope: 04-audit-read moves out of mission 01 into mission 02 as the brownfield enhancement slice (impact analysis over the shipped audit table); mission 02 = that enhancement + one bug-fix slice (dogfood defect, seeded and disclosed if none) + the fault-injection drills; custom alias and expiry (FR-11, FR-12) are dropped from the plan (requirements baseline marks them dropped with this decision); mission 03 unchanged. (3) Mission 01 wave 2 = 02-analytics || 03-operate concurrently (wave 3 disappears); ordered custody for docs/api/openapi.json and application.properties as you already designed. (4) The operator is adding a second reviewer seat and a second QA seat (Codex) and a workflow variant that routes to them, so concurrent slices do not queue on one judge; use the variant for 03-operate. (5) When wave 2 starts building, decompose mission 03 in parallel (requirements and planning seats are idle during builds) so its ambiguity decision reaches the human on Friday. (6) The slice workflows are being changed by the operator to merge code_review+security_review into one review packet and integrate+slice_accept into one lead step; standalone spec edits apply at the next hop, nothing to do on your side."

Please: re-tier 02 and 03 (tier_reason citing this decision), update mission.yaml composition / wave map / compiled graph, move 04-audit-read's scaffold to missions/02-brownfield (or re-create it there), ask the review agent for a scoped re-check of the amended decomposition (a queue item, not the completed lifecycle step), and record everything in NOTES.md. Do not interrupt the in-flight design of 01-create-redirect.
summary: HUMAN DECISION (fast plan): delegate slice plan-locks, 04-audit-read -> mission 02, drop alias/expiry, w2 = 02||03, 2nd reviewer+QA seats coming, overlap mission 03
